meta.name: capital-allocation
meta.description: Evaluates where to spend limited capital — investment appraisal, hurdle rates, payback, and comparing proposals that are not alike. Use this to evaluate an investment or major purchase, compare competing funding requests, set a hurdle rate, decide between building and buying, or review whether past investments delivered what was claimed.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 评估投资与采购,合理分配每一笔资金
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果 你需要决定把钱投向哪个项目或评估一笔大额采购是否值得。
copy.tagline_en: Evaluate investments and allocate limited capital wisely.
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you must rank investment opportunities and set hurdle rates.

howto.what: 装好后，Claude 会按增量现金流原则评估投资或大额采购：不算沉没成本，计入机会成本与营运资本；用净现值做决策，用回收期衡量流动性与不确定性；还会追问前提、反事实与责任人，并建议分阶段投入和事后复盘。
howto.when: 当你提出要评估一笔投资或大额采购、比较多个资金申请、设定最低收益率（或询问该自建还是外购、复盘过往投资）时，Claude 会触发这套评估流程。

say.text: 帮我把这两个投资方案做净现值对比，然后解释回收期。
say.note: Claude 会梳理增量现金流后对比，并说明两者的不同含义。

say.text: 这个项目该自建还是外购？帮我算算哪个更划算。
say.note: 它会用资本配置框架评估自建与外购两种选项。

say.text: 复盘去年批准的那个扩建项目，实际回报和当初承诺差多少？
say.note: 它会对比已批案例的真实结果与当初承诺。

howto.what_en: Claude evaluates spending on incremental cash flow: sunk costs ignored, opportunity cost and working capital counted, NPV for decisions, payback for liquidity/uncertainty; it probes assumptions, counterfactuals, ownership, suggests staging and post-audits.
howto.when_en: When you ask Claude to evaluate an investment or major purchase, compare funding requests, set a hurdle rate, decide build vs buy, or review past investments.

say_en.text: Compare these two investment proposals on NPV, then explain the payback.
say_en.note: Claude compares incremental cash flows and clarifies each metric.

say_en.text: Should we build or buy this? Help me weigh the options.
say_en.note: It assesses both options under the framework.

say_en.text: How did last year's expansion actually perform against what we approved?
say_en.note: Reviews realized outcomes against the approved case.
